summary: Static PVC names: database postgres-15-<aap_cr_name>-postgres-15-0 (ReadWriteOnce), hub file storage <instance_name>-hub-file-storage (ReadWriteMany, when storage_type is file) and hub Redis <instance_name>-hub-redis-data (ReadWriteOnce).
questions: What PVC names does the AAP Operator expect?
Name of the automation hub file storage PVC
AAP database PVC name for static provisioning

answer_card.title: Static PVC names
answer_card.answer_md:
| Component | PVC name | Access |
|---|---|---|
| Database | `postgres-15-<aap_cr_name>-postgres-15-0` | RWO |
| Hub storage (file) | `<instance_name>-hub-file-storage` | RWX |
| Hub Redis | `<instance_name>-hub-redis-data` | RWO |
